# porch Provider

Manages a [Porch](https://github.com/aurimasniekis/go-porch) installation (self-hosted IAM/SSO) through its management API. Authenticate with an automation token (`porch_at_…`, ADR-0041) issued by an installation owner.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    porch = {
      source = "aurimasniekis/porch"
    }
  }
}

# The endpoint and token can also come from PORCH_ENDPOINT and PORCH_TOKEN.
provider "porch" {
  endpoint = "https://auth.example.com"
  token    = var.porch_token # an automation token (porch_at_…) issued by an installation owner

  # Optional: trust a private CA in addition to the system roots.
  # ca_file = "/etc/ssl/private-ca.pem"
}

variable "porch_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ca_file` (String) Path to a PEM file with additional CA certificates to trust (private PKI). May also be set with `PORCH_CA_FILE`.
- `endpoint` (String) Public URL of the Porch installation, for example `https://auth.example.com`. May also be set with the `PORCH_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Automation token (`porch_at_…`). May also be set with the `PORCH_TOKEN` environment variable.
